description: Flags active employees missing required bank account numbers before payroll disbursement.
Flags active employees missing statutory tax identification numbers.
Flags duplicate time submissions sharing identical submission reference codes or employee and date.
Flags approved hours exceeding the pay group's maximum period hours or single-shift outliers > 16h.
Flags duplicate allowances with identical reference codes or duplicate grants of single-grant allowances.
Flags unapproved or pending time entries within a pay period, preventing premature inclusion or export.
Flags unpaid leave deductions that are applied multiple times for the same leave record or period.
Flags arithmetic discrepancies between net pay and calculated component totals (basic + overtime + allowances - deductions - unpaid leave).
